deliverables.shellShowLinkDataRendering: MasterDetailExpansionShell now renders a MudCard with LinkDataHeading above the target card when ShowLinkData=true and LinkDataContent is supplied. Two cascading values (DetailsContext + LinkContext) wrap the render tree so consumer fields drive both dirty trackers.
deliverables.shellTargetEditabilityModes: TargetEditability.Editable (current behavior), ReadOnly (permanent IsTargetReadOnly=true, no toggle), and ReadOnlyWithToggle (toggle button in target card header for ShowLinkData=true, or above DetailsContent for ShowLinkData=false). Toggle flips IsTargetReadOnly and fires OnTargetEditingToggled. New TargetCardHeading/EditRecordLabel/LockRecordLabel parameters.
deliverables.shellLinkContextAndAnyDirty: LinkContext<TLink> with SetLinkDirty + ResetLinkDirty plumbing. PrimaryActionLabel + IsPrimaryActionUseOnly now consider AnyDirty (entity OR link dirty). HandlePrimaryActionAsync + HandleDefaultSaveAsync pack both dirty flags into the SaveRequest and reset both on successful save.
deliverables.togglePreservesUseLabel: Toggling ReadOnlyWithToggle to editable does NOT set _entityDirty or _linkDirty by itself; only an actual field change does. Verified by Shell_ToggleWithoutChange_PreservesUseLabel.
deliverables.selectionResetSemantics: NotifyRowSelected re-applies the TargetEditability default to IsTargetReadOnly (reverts to readonly baseline when reviewing existing rows). ResetSelection (Add) forces target editable so the user can fill the new entity, and clears both dirty flags.
deliverables.scenario4bMigration: OrderDetail's Add-Product flow migrated from the ad-hoc _showProductPicker panel to a ProductLinePickerDialog hosting PickOrAddDialog<ProductDto, ProductDto, OrderItemDto> with ShowLinkData=true, TargetEditability=ReadOnly. The Quantity/Discount link card is the join payload; UnitPrice flows from the picked product. OrderDetailState.AddItemFromDialogAsync is the new persistence path.
deliverables.scenario4bToggleVariant: OrderDetail's Items grid gained an 'Inspect line' icon-button. Click opens ProductLinePickerDialog with AllowTargetEdit=true and ExistingLine=<row> so the dialog opens with the existing product+payload review-only; toggling unlocks the target product card.
deliverables.scenario4aDemoPage: New /admin/order-item-tuner (OrderItemTunerPage) renders MasterDetailExpansionShell with ShowGrid=false, ShowLinkData=true, TargetEditability=Editable. Both target and link cards editable; snackbar reports which dirty flags fired on save (UI-only demo, no API write — production wiring deferred).
deliverables.scenario3InspectToDecide: CustomerPickerDialog gained an InspectToDecide parameter (default false). When true, TargetEditability=ReadOnlyWithToggle so reviewers drill in read-only and unlock on demand. OrderDetail's customer field surfaces an 'Inspect' button alongside 'Pick customer' to launch this variant.
deliverables.orderCreatePageNavigatesAfterSave: OrderCreatePage now navigates to /orders/{newId} after the order saves so the Add-Product flow becomes accessible (the items tab is only visible when !IsNew).
deliverables.bUnitTestsAdded: 7 new MasterDetailExpansionShellTests methods covering: link card with heading; target card with heading; ReadOnly mode has no toggle button + IsTargetReadOnly=true; ReadOnlyWithToggle flips state + fires OnTargetEditingToggled; link-dirty alone flips PrimaryActionLabel to SaveAndUseLabel; toggle-without-change preserves UseLabel; SaveRequest carries both EntityDirty + LinkDirty.
deliverables.playwrightTestsAdded: Three new Playwright test classes: OrderProductLinePickerWorkflowTests (4b end-to-end through the migrated Add-Product flow with DB verification), OrderItemTunerPageWorkflowTests (4a layout + dirty-state snackbar messages), CustomerPickerInspectToDecideTests (Scenario 3 inspect → toggle → edit → label-flip flow).
deliverables.verifierFindingsFixed: GPT-5.4 verifier (cost: $0.18) flagged 3 issues. Major: HandleUsePickedAsync relied on DOM bubbling rather than explicit buffer hydration — now awaits HandleRowSelectedAsync. Major: Review-line dialog ignored the clicked item — added ExistingLine parameter + OnInitializedAsync population. Minor: ShowGrid=false branch missed the toggle button rendering — mirrored from ShowGrid=true branch. See issue-logs/session-004.json.
